newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan receives 10 bids for export of rice.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan receives 10 bids for export of rice.

text.p: The state-run Rice Export Corp of Pakistan said on Tuesday it had received 10 bids for the sale and export of 40,000/45,000 tonnes of IRRI-6 variety rice.
One corporation official said the lowest bid was at $238 and the highest $360 per tonne CIF. He gave no details of the bids and parties behind them.
A decision would be taken in two or three days.
One exporter said some importers abroad might have taken part in the tender on behalf of Iraq following its deal with the U.N. on oil for food, but this was not immediately confirmed.
The Rice Export Corp had entered the export market after a gap of several weeks, the official said.
